name: El Choro Inca trail
why: From a 4,850 m pass of llamas and snow down a pre-Hispanic stone road into the cloud forest of the Yungas, 3,500 m lower, in three days.
book: Cotapata park ticket and small community fees on the way. Taxi or minibus from La Paz to La Cumbre (1 h). A guide is advised: the trail is remote.
water: Streams all the way below the pass (treat); small shops in Chucura and Challapampa.
dangers: Altitude: La Paz is at 3,600 m; spend two or three days there before any hike.
The pass can be in snow and fog.
Slippery stones and mud in the forest.
turnaround: Be over the Apacheta pass by 11:00, or come back to La Cumbre.

points.name: La Cumbre
